case_scope: short1 compact dry-line one-tank/two-branch initialization and 0.05 s continuation; diagnostics only

interpretation.effective_source_strength: Because the source diagonal is proportional to mixture rho, gas-only cells contribute little: the water partial-density coefficient is 50.0%, 50.3%, and 65.1% of a hypothetical all-water source zone at the three checkpoints. The lumped moving-front model applies the full assumed Cd/K loss at the valve seat throughout, so it does not represent this progressive wetting of a 0.30 m distributed zone. This is consistent with, but does not prove the cause of, its lower predicted flow/drawdown.
interpretation.limitations: The 4.957 ms state is from the separate half-deltaT run, not the original-deltaT continuation. The full source cell-zone includes both tanks' four branch valves; the reduced model is Tank A representative. Results are early-time diagnostics on the same compact, quality-limited mesh, not a validation or causal isolation experiment.
interpretation.native_vs_reduced_storage: Tank A native drawdown uses tankAWaterZone plus the small initial water fraction in tankAHeadspaceZone. Relative to the model's own initial state, native drawdown and lineAInitialZone water gain are 0.548 L by 4.957 ms and 6.547/6.549 L by 50.021 ms; the reduced model gives 0.394 L and 4.573 L. No water reached externalAirZone at these checkpoints. At 50.021 ms the native-global alpha-volume change is +0.00405 L, small relative to the 1.974 L native-model line-storage difference.
interpretation.pressure_and_work: Volume-weighted static p means on the x<2.25 and x>=2.25 cell-center subsets differ by 0.572 MPa at 4.957 ms and 0.671 MPa at 50.021 ms. These are spatial source-zone diagnostics, not cross-sectional pressure taps. Four-zone instantaneous source power contractions are 287.5 kW and 249.8 kW at those times (about half for Tank A's two branches); they are not integrated energy losses or a fitted Cd.
interpretation.source_zone_phase_coverage: At t=0 each 0.30 m source zone is split almost exactly in half by the assumed x=2.25 m seat: upstream half alpha.water=1 and downstream half alpha.water=0. By 4.957 ms, mean zone alpha-water is 0.513 (2.6% wetting in its downstream half); at 50.021 ms it is 0.656 (31.1% of downstream-half zone volume wet).

limits: No CFD run or field modification was performed.
The t=0 rho is reconstructed from the configured incompressible-water constant density and ideal-air EOS; later rho fields are native and compared against this reconstruction.
Tank/line inventories are cellZone integrals of alpha.water times native cell volume; no extrapolation between native snapshots.
The reduced-network result is a frozen exploratory model; close drawdown is not validation of valve behavior.
Upstream/downstream static pressure means are spatial diagnostics only; the distributed source and moving interface prevent interpreting them as a calibrated valve Δp or Cd.

constituent_partial_density_accounting_k.interpretation: bookkeeping decomposition under one shared mixture velocity; not a phase-specific force or power model

per_branch_samples.density_source: reconstructed alpha*rhoWater+(1-alpha)*p/(R*T); no rho field saved at t=0
per_branch_samples.diagonal_coefficient_meaning: fvOptions directly applies a negative source-matrix diagonal. The actual solver form, base UEqn == fvOptions(rho,U), makes that a negative RHS force and a positive resistance when moved to the left-hand operator. The contraction is an instantaneous dissipative power proxy using shared mixture U.

sampling.branch_clustering: Four volume-weighted y-center clusters in allFourValves cells; each cluster is a spatial band, not a prescribed physical branch label.
sampling.near_0p005: half-dt run native checkpoint 0.00495695923227 s, not exact 0.005 s; different maxDeltaT only, same mesh/partition/physics
sampling.phase_weighting: native alpha.water with partial-density decomposition alpha*rhoWater and (1-alpha)*p/(R*T); common velocity means this is an accounting split, not a phase-specific force model.

source_definition.actual_solver_momentum_assembly: fvm::ddt(rho,U) + fvm::div(rhoPhi,U) - fvm::Sp(contErr,U) + MRF.DDt(rho,U) + turbulence.divDevRhoReff(U) == fvOptions(rho,U)
source_definition.power_limit: Reported fvOptions RHS force/power are instantaneous contractions using native shared mixture velocity; positive implied dissipation is not integrated over time, not a phase-resolved work transfer, and not a calibrated pressure drop.
source_definition.source_matrix_sign: The code subtracts a positive coefficient from the fvOptions source-matrix diagonal. The actual solver form is base UEqn == fvOptions(rho,U), so the negative option diagonal is a negative RHS force and becomes a positive resistance when moved to the left-hand operator. This is consistent with valve-loss intent; it is not evidence of anti-damping.
